newsitem.title: USA: Transco cuts pressure in Pa. gas line.
newsitem.headline: Transco cuts pressure in Pa. gas line.

text.p: Transco said Wednesday an obstruction in its Leidy, Pa., natural gas pipeline has forced it to reduce pressure in the line but that this has not affected gas storage obligations.
"We are meeting all storage obligations," a company spokesman said.
The company would not disclose the volume of gas currently flowing through the line, but denied rumors heard in the gas market early Wednesday that compressors on the line were down for repairs.
"One of the dehydration pieces got into our line. There is nothing wrong with the two compressors, but we had to lower pressure on the Leidy line," said a second Transco official.
The company said firm transmission on the line so far was unaffected, but declined to discuss what impact the problem might be having on interruptible transmission.
Company officials said they so far did not know when the problem could be corrected.
Transco is a subsidiary of Williams Cos Inc.
